{
    info_new <- get_info(package_name, package_version_new)
    info_old <- get_info(package_name, package_version_old)
    dep <- compare_dependencies(info_new, info_old)
    funct <- compare_funcs(info_new, info_old)
    diff_tm <- compare_tm(package_name, package_version_new, 
        package_version_old)
    pkg_diff <- list(package = package_name, version_new = package_version_new, 
        version_old = package_version_old, dependencies_diff = dep, 
        functions_diff = funct, test_m = diff_tm)
    return(pkg_diff)
}
tm.description:
This function retrieves information for two versions of an R package,
compares their dependencies, exported functions, and test metrics,
and returns the differences as a structured R list.

Inner-joins two data frames on key column(s) and compares a single column
between them. Returns the keys, the two suffixed columns, and a logical
`different` flag with NA-aware rules.

tm.function_body:
{
    new_funcs <- new_funcs$functions
    old_funcs <- old_funcs$functions
    new_names <- names(new_funcs)
    old_names <- names(old_funcs)
    new_names <- new_names[!is.na(new_names) & nzchar(new_names)]
    old_names <- old_names[!is.na(old_names) & nzchar(old_names)]
    added_names <- setdiff(new_names, old_names)
    removed_names <- setdiff(old_names, new_names)
    common_names <- intersect(new_names, old_names)
    modified <- list()
    for (fn in common_names) {
        old_formals <- old_funcs[[fn]]
        new_formals <- new_funcs[[fn]]
        if (!identical(old_formals, new_formals)) {
            modified[[fn]] <- list(old = old_formals, new = new_formals)
        }
    }
    list(added = new_funcs[added_names], removed = old_funcs[removed_names], 
        modified = modified)
}
tm.description: Compare Exported Functions Between Two Versions

tm.function_body:
{
    tm_list_new <- risk.assessr::generate_traceability_matrix(package_name, 
        version_new)
    tm_list_old <- risk.assessr::generate_traceability_matrix(package_name, 
        version_old)
    name_new <- paste0(package_name, "_", version_new)
    name_old <- paste0(package_name, "_", version_old)
    func_cmp <- purrr::map_dfr(fields, function(field) {
        compare_column(tm_list_new$tm, tm_list_old$tm, key = "exported_function", 
            param_col = field, name1 = name_new, name2 = name_old, 
            only_diff = TRUE) %>% dplyr::transmute(exported_function, 
            field = field, `:=`(!!paste0("value_", name_new), 
                .data[[paste0(field, "_", name_new)]]), `:=`(!!paste0("value_", 
                name_old), .data[[paste0(field, "_", name_old)]]))
    }) %>% dplyr::arrange(exported_function, field)
    func_cmp
}
tm.description:
This function compares the traceability matrices (TMs) generated for two
versions of an R package. It identifies differences in selected fields
(such as function type, body, and description) across versions.
Parses a string of dependencies (e.g. from 'Imports' or 'Depends') into a data frame with package names and versions.
Helper that formats a list of function arguments and their default values.

Builds a nested list representation of a package’s **function call tree** using
[pkgnet::FunctionReporter]. This is usually consumed by
[print_function_tree()] for pretty-printing, but you can also
work with the nested list directly.
Downloads a specified version of a CRAN package and extracts DESCRIPTION info and function names.

This helper function prints the differences between functions in two versions
of a package. It shows which functions were added, removed, or modified,
including their arguments.

Pretty-prints a hierarchical representation of a package's **function call tree**
as produced by `function_tree_nested()`. Leaves (no further calls) are shown
as plain names (their values are `NULL`). Cycles are annotated.
